name: Mental Breakdown Germany 2019
information: Mental Breakdown Germany 2019 is the third episode of Mental Breakdown competitions in Germany. **Important:** This is not a typical Speedsolving-Competition. Therefore, we do not hold the event "3x3x3 Cube". If you want to solve the classic 3x3x3 Cube competively, you can find other German competitions [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?utf8=✓&region=Germany&search=&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). The entrance fee for competitors is 7 Euro for the competition with pre-payment. Since most official events are spread on both competition days, every registration is automatically valid for both days.
